title: Mapping decision tree outputs
statement: Let $g$ be a function from a type $\alpha$ to a type $\beta$. Applying $g$ to the outputs of a decision tree replaces each leaf value $a$ by $g(a)$ and preserves every query and its two child subtrees, producing a tree with leaf values in $\beta$.
hypotheses_covered: A decision tree on $n$ coordinates indexed by an available subset
